task.description:
Implement AGT-01, AGT-02, AGT-03, AGT-04 per the design at src/design/AGT-01-04-agent-artifacts.md on branch feature/WF02-agt01-04-20260818.

Read each requirement: python tools/reqctl.py show AGT-01 (and AGT-02, AGT-03, AGT-04 individually).
Read the design: src/design/AGT-01-04-agent-artifacts.md
Read existing patterns: src/ directory, recent migrations, existing route handlers.

Required implementation:

1. Migration: create a new migration file in migrations/ with DDL for:
   - staging.agent_artifacts table (id, tenant_id, kind, task_spec_id, attempt_count, spec_hash, payload JSONB, touched_at, created_at) with UNIQUE(tenant_id, task_spec_id, attempt_count)
   - staging.task_specs table (id, tenant_id, spec_hash CHAR(64), spec JSONB, orchestrator_principal, created_at) with UNIQUE(tenant_id, spec_hash)
   - ArtifactSubmissionRejected audit event type

2. Zig source code in src/ for:
   - AGT-01: POST /api/v1/agent/artifacts handler with kind enum discrimination and per-kind closed schema validation (400 unknown_artifact_kind, 422 artifact_payload_invalid with JSON pointer)
   - AGT-01: GET /api/v1/agent/artifacts/schemas endpoint returning versioned schema catalog
   - AGT-02: Environment class check from deployment config (HTTP 403 wrong_environment before payload parse); ArtifactSubmissionRejected audit event on rejection
   - AGT-03: Idempotency via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, task_spec_id, attempt_count) DO UPDATE SET touched_at=now() RETURNING xmax=0 AS inserted; return 201 (new), 200 (re-hit same hash), 409 spec_hash_mismatch (different hash), 409 attempt_count_regressed (submitted < stored max)
   - AGT-04: task_specs endpoint(s); spec_hash as SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON (64 hex chars); 409 task_spec_immutable on update attempt; 404 task_spec_not_found when artifact references unknown spec

3. Register new routes in the router.

Build must pass: zig build
Commit all changes to feature/WF02-agt01-04-20260818.

result.summary: Implemented AGT-01..04: artifact envelope handler (POST /api/v1/agent/artifacts), schema catalog endpoint (GET /api/v1/agent/artifacts/schemas), environment enforcement (AGT-02), idempotency via xmax trick (AGT-03), and immutable task-spec binding (AGT-04). Migration 1171 creates staging.agent_artifacts. All routes wired in main.zig. zig build exits 0.

issues.description: staging.agent_artifacts.task_spec_id has FK REFERENCES task_specs(task_spec_id) where task_specs is a per-tenant schema table. In the staging schema (global), this FK cross-references whichever schema is in search_path at migration time. This is a potential design inconsistency that should be reviewed by CODE-DESIGNER.
